readerCopy.body: A relationship can be good and still be organized around a version of life that is becoming harder to keep. When Venus squares the North Node, connection and forward movement create friction around work, location, schedule, spending, values, or priorities that no longer fit the old terms. Affection does not automatically resolve a structural mismatch. The tension becomes useful when the arrangement is allowed to change before everyone assumes the only choices are preserving the bond unchanged or abandoning it.
